question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank 1.
solution: The correct answer is** "helpful."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Helpful"** means providing assistance or support. (सहायता करने वाला, सहायतापूर्ण, सहायक, सहायता के लिए तत्‍पर) • **Example**: *She is very **helpful**__.* • It is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank because it fits the context of the sentence. • The word is an adjective and modifies the subject of the sentence. • The correct answer is option 1. • **Correct passage:** I hope you will find this series __**helpful**__ in developing language skills of the learners through diverse reading ______ (2) ______ such as fairy tales, fables, classics, adventure, biography, drama and so on. The prose pieces ______ (3) ______ for intensive language study while the poems ______ (4) ______ enable children to develop an ear for ______ (5) ______ and rhythm. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 2, "demanding"**, means requiring a lot of effort or attention. ((कार्य) प्रचुर प्रयास, सावधानी, दक्षता आदि की अपेक्षा वाला) • **Option 3, "distasteful"**, means unpleasant or disagreeable. (अरुचिकर या बुरा लगने वाला) • **Option 4, "challenging"**, means difficult or requiring effort to accomplish. (चुनौती-भरा) 3e:Teba, The correct answer is **"genres."**
